arguments.question: What technical issues should I fix first?

examples.description: Ask what needs fixing in an earlier result. Replace the asset keys with asset_key values from your own earlier image results.

description: Analyze a photo with vision (subjects, defects, OCR text, composition) and return a description. Token-billed at the platform's vision rates. Returns JSON {text, price, next}. Refuses: SIMPLER_MEDIA_INPUT_MISSING (pass the url or the asset_key), SIMPLER_MEDIA_FOREIGN_KEY (use this workspace's asset_key), SIMPLER_MEDIA_URL_REFUSED (use https, data:image or an asset_key), SIMPLER_MEDIA_PIN_TOO_LARGE (under 20MB), SIMPLER_MEDIA_UNKNOWN_TYPE (send PNG, JPEG or WebP), INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS (add credits). NEXT: act on the findings with image.inpaint, image.cut_background or image.upscale.

image_asset_key.description: Photo to analyze, as the asset_key of an earlier image result for this workspace (edit-projects/<tenant>/... or images/<tenant>/...). A key from another workspace is refused (SIMPLER_MEDIA_FOREIGN_KEY).

image_url.description: Photo to analyze: a public https URL, a data:image/...;base64 URL, or the url/url_path of an earlier image result (max 20MB; PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF; SVG is refused). Pass this or the matching *_asset_key, not both.

request_ref.description: Optional idempotency key (1-64 chars: letters, digits, . _ : -). Retrying with the same request_ref and the same arguments within 24 hours returns the first result at $0 with replayed: true; the same request_ref with different arguments is refused (SIMPLER_IMAGE_REQUEST_REF_CONFLICT), and so is a retry whose first result was deleted since (SIMPLER_IMAGE_REQUEST_REF_RESULT_DELETED): send a new request_ref to run it again.

name: image.describe
